+from datetime import date as Date

+def _to_date(value):
+    if isinstance(value, Date):
+        return value
+    return datetime.strptime(value, "%Y-%m-%d").date()
+
+
+def _is_blackout(date, blackout_ranges):
+    booking_date = _to_date(date)
+    return any(_to_date(start) <= booking_date <= _to_date(end) for start, end in blackout_ranges or [])

 def can_book(user, date, capacity, blackout_ranges=None):
